title: Dinakarī (Muktāvalīprakāśa)

attribution.tradition: Begun by Mahādeva Bhaṭṭa (son of Bālakṛṣṇa, as its opening verse says) and completed by his son Dinakara Bhaṭṭa, after whom it is named.

summary: Navya-Nyāya sub-commentary on Viśvanātha Nyāyapañcānana's Nyāyasiddhāntamuktāvalī (on the Kārikāvalī / Bhāṣāpariccheda), printed with the Muktāvalī and the Rāmarudrī; among other things it reports the rival counts of the means of knowledge.

editions.name: Kārikāvalī with Nyāyasiddhāntamuktāvalī, Dinakarī and Rāmarudrī (1899), eBhāratī-sampat Ebharati-8692

notes: Identification of the starred commentary layer of the 1899 print as the Dinakarī rests on its opening verse (Mahādeva) — moderate confidence.
